tests.fail_or_repair: Open a person-status docket and downgrade VA row evidence to denominator state.
tests.label: Person, authority, and discharge/status lane
tests.question: Does the packet bind the veteran, survivor, dependent, caregiver, representative, service/discharge/character lane, address, and urgency before accepting VA status evidence?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat claims inventory or completed-claim counts as support until payment and correction evidence are joined.
tests.label: Claim, evidence, exam, and payment
tests.question: Are claim type, evidence, service records, C&P exam, rating, decision, notice, payment, dependent/survivor effects, and error-correction receipts separated?

tests.fail_or_repair: Flag rating criteria/exam quality for review before relying on percentage or decision.
tests.label: Rating criteria and modernization risk
tests.question: Does the packet identify rating criteria vintage, body system, medical/earnings-loss assumptions, exam quality, contractor oversight, and rework risk?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat PACT dashboards as implementation evidence only until person-level toxic-exposure claim and care evidence exist.
tests.label: PACT Act and toxic-exposure path
tests.question: Are exposure, presumptive condition, PACT eligibility, health-care enrollment, claim, exam, decision, payment, and treatment path joined?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not score eligibility as care until appointment, medication, and follow-up evidence exist.
tests.label: Health enrollment, priority, and care delivery
tests.question: Does eligibility or priority group connect to appointment, medication, specialty, travel, telehealth, covered benefits, and care-plan continuity?

tests.fail_or_repair: Downgrade authorization to routing evidence until provider and clinical continuity evidence are present.
tests.label: Community-care authorization and follow-up
tests.question: Are community-care referral, eligibility, authorization, provider scheduling, records exchange, claim payment, and clinical follow-up joined?

tests.fail_or_repair: Open an appeal-continuity repair file when docket status is cited as remedy proof.
tests.label: Appeal, review, representative, and remand continuity
tests.question: Do supplemental claim, higher-level review, Board appeal, hearing, hardship, representative, remand, and decision notice remain connected to payment/care consequences?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat EHRM and portal milestones as source-currentness warnings until record-level continuity is verified.
tests.label: Records, EHRM, portal, and digital handoff
tests.question: Are claims file, medical record, service records, EHRM site state, portal/identity, medication, problem-list, referral, downtime, and correction path joined?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat hotline availability or voucher allocation as stabilization without handoff, placement, and follow-up.
tests.label: Crisis, homelessness, and housing stabilization
tests.question: Are Veterans Crisis Line, homeless call-center, HUD-VASH/SSVF/GPD, ID, income, lease-up, case management, safety plan, and follow-up joined?

tests.fail_or_repair: Keep program rows open until school payment, caregiver support, and transition outcome evidence exists.
tests.label: Education, caregiver, transition, and outcome closure
tests.question: Are GI Bill entitlement/school certification/payment, caregiver eligibility/assignment/stipend/respite/wellness contacts, and transition outcomes joined to remedy receipts?

use_rule: Run veterans-continuity tests whenever VA claims, ratings, PACT Act evidence, health-care eligibility, community care, appeals, EHRM, crisis lines, homelessness programs, GI Bill, caregiver support, survivor/dependent benefits, or VA digital-status surfaces are cited as proof that a veteran, survivor, dependent, caregiver, or family received support. Separate person, claim, exam, rating, appeal, care, authorization, records, housing, crisis, education, caregiver, payment, remedy, and source-currentness before treating a claim row, rating, dashboard, eligibility, authorization, docket, voucher, certification, or caregiver row as support.
